stem: The Bessemer steel process affected westward expansion in the United States by enabling —

options.label: A
options.text: clipper ships to be built in order to transport passengers from the East Coast to the West Coast

options.label: B
options.text: interstate canal systems to be built in order to transport agricultural goods from west to east

options.label: C
options.text: Conestoga wagons to be built in order to carry people and goods to the West

options.label: D
options.text: railroads to be built in order to carry people and goods to the West
